The headline-must-be-PIN policy (T9) supersedes the D-11 retained-surface-form decision: the bare molecule must emit the substitutive PIN, not the deprecated retained name.

entries.name: acetophenone
entries.note: Wave2 T1d RET demotion: 'acetophenone' is a retained name for general nomenclature only; the PIN is the substitutive ketone 1-phenylethan-1-one (BB P-64.2.1.2). No hc_override so it filters from BOTH the hand-curated dict and OPSIN promotion, forcing the systematic PIN. Available under --trivial via GENERAL_RETAINED_NAMES (RET-01 cumene/diphenylamine precedent).

entries.name: dimethyl sulfoxide

Filters the hand-curated dict so the new substitutive P-63.6 builder emits; available under --trivial (acetophenone precedent).

entries.name: triethanolamine
entries.note: Wave2 T5a RET demotion: general nomenclature only; the PIN is the multiplicative 2,2',2''-nitrilotri(ethan-1-ol) (BB P-15.3.2.1 verbatim PIN example), emitted by rules/multiplicative.py's acyclic nitrilo star path (acetophenone precedent).

entries.name: diethanolamine
entries.note: Wave2 T5a RET demotion: general nomenclature only; the PIN is the multiplicative 2,2'-azanediyldi(ethan-1-ol) (P-15.3.1.2.1.1 azanediyl preselected prefix + the P-15.3.2.1 di(ethan-1-ol) pattern), emitted by the acyclic NH-bridge path (acetophenone precedent).

entries.name: terephthalyl alcohol
entries.note: Wave2 T5a RET demotion: general nomenclature only; the PIN is the multiplicative (benzene-1,4-diyl)dimethanol (P-15.3.2.1 mononuclear methanol units, locants omitted per P-14.3.4.2), emitted by the central-arene arms path (acetophenone precedent).

entries.name: dimethyl sulfone
entries.note: Wave2 T3b RET demotion: PIN is '(methanesulfonyl)methane' (parallel to BB 28115 '(ethanesulfonyl)ethane'). Filters the hand-curated dict; available under --trivial.

entries.name: chromene
entries.note: Neither bare 'chromene' nor '2H-chromene' is the PIN; the PIN ring parent is '2H-1-benzopyran' (P-19(d): the systematic benzo name is preferred for chromene; line 19453 '2H-1-benzopyran (PIN)  2H-chromene'). chromene is general-nomenclature only. Catalog now emits 2H-/4H-1-benzopyran.

entries.name: chromone
entries.note: Retained 'chromone' not PIN; PIN is 4H-1-benzopyran-4-one (P-64.2.2.2.2 ketone = direct substitution of the 4H >CH2; 1-benzopyran is the PIN ring parent per P-19(d), not chromen). De-headled from retained + NATURAL_PRODUCT_DERIVATIVES -> emitted by the cyclic-oxo engine.

entries.name: coumarin
entries.note: Retained 'coumarin' not PIN; PIN is 2H-1-benzopyran-2-one. De-headled from retained -> emitted by the renamed fused_heterocycles catalog entry.

entries.name: thiochromene
entries.note: thiochromene not PIN; PIN ring parent is 2H-1-benzothiopyran (the chalcogen analogue uses 1-benzothiopyran, not thiochromene). Catalog now emits 2H-1-benzothiopyran (v23 IH-01g).

entries.name: xanthone
entries.note: Retained 'xanthone' not PIN; PIN is 9H-xanthen-9-one (xanthene IS a retained PIN ring parent, 9H-xanthene; the 9-one). De-headled from retained -> cyclic-oxo engine emits the PIN (v23 IH-01g).

entries.name: isochromene
entries.note: isochromene not PIN; PIN is 1H-2-benzopyran. De-headled from the OPSIN-import retained alias -> the new fused_heterocycles catalog entry emits the PIN (v23 IH-01g).

entries.name: chromane
entries.note: chromane not PIN; PIN is 3,4-dihydro-2H-1-benzopyran. De-headled from the OPSIN-import retained alias -> renamed catalog entry emits the PIN (v23 IH-01h; the cyclic-oxo engine now names chromanone derivatives correctly so the rename is safe).

entries.name: isochromane
entries.note: isochromane not PIN; PIN is 3,4-dihydro-1H-2-benzopyran. De-headled -> renamed catalog entry (v23 IH-01h).

entries.name: thiochromane

entries.name: chromanone
entries.note: Retained 'chromanone' not PIN; PIN is 2,3-dihydro-4H-1-benzopyran-4-one (the 4-one substitutes the 4H >CH2). De-headled from NATURAL_PRODUCT_DERIVATIVES + here -> cyclic-oxo engine emits the PIN (v23 IH-01h).

entries.name: isophthalic acid
entries.note: D-FOLLOWON item 2: 'isophthalic acid' is a retained NON-PIN name (general nomenclature only); the PIN is the substitutive ring di-acid benzene-1,3-dicarboxylic acid. Deny so the RETAINED_NAME dispatch misses and the systematic pipeline emits the PIN -- exactly as terephthalic (benzene-1,4-) and phthalic (benzene-1,2-) already do (no retained entry). Same de-headline pattern as anisole->methoxybenzene / biphenyl->1,1'-biphenyl / coumarin->2H-1-benzopyran-2-one. SMILES key matches the canonical retained_names.py key. No hc_override -> filters the hand-curated side. Distinct name from 'phthalic anhydride' (retained PIN, UNAFFECTED by exact-name deny).

entries.name: naphtho-1,4-quinone

entries.name: anthra-9,10-quinone

entries.name: anthra-1,4-quinone

entries.name: benzo-1,4-quinone

entries.name: glycerol
entries.note: Task 1.10 (PIN-policy): 'glycerol' is a retained name for general nomenclature only; the PIN is the systematic triol propane-1,2,3-triol. Deny (no hc_override -> filters the hand-curated side) so the RETAINED_NAME dispatch misses and the systematic pipeline emits the PIN; the trivial stays reachable via --trivial (GENERAL_RETAINED_NAMES). Controller-verified: systematic engine emits propane-1,2,3-triol with the entry gone.

entries.name: allyl alcohol

entries.name: chloroform
entries.note: Task 1.10 (PIN-policy): 'chloroform' is a retained name for general nomenclature only; the PIN is the substitutive halide trichloromethane. So O=COO uses the hand-curated exact-SMILES retained PIN 'methaneperoxoic acid' (phosgene model) in retained_names.py; this deny (no hc_override) keeps 'performic acid' out of the merged PIN dict and routes it to the --trivial GENERAL fallback.
